Motor-controller vibration tray handoff. The desktop contains `/home/user/Desktop/board_input.kicad_pcb`, `/home/user/Desktop/mechanical_requirements.json`, `/home/user/Desktop/connector_keepouts.csv`, `/home/user/Desktop/enclosure_seed.scad`, and `/home/user/Desktop/handoff_notes.md`. The handoff notes are supplementary and cannot override the KiCad board, requirements JSON, or connector CSV. KiCad-derived JSON, CSV, and SCAD handoffs may be generated by a deterministic parser within the KiCad stage; kicad-cli must also successfully load and export the board before OpenSCAD consumes those handoffs, but no particular helper script name or ordering between those KiCad-stage operations is required. Complete the CLI-only handoff in the real sequence KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender. KiCad is authoritative for the PCB outline, thickness, footprint centers, mounting axes, heights, and keepout radii; the requirements are authoritative for installed placement, tray/lid/rib/standoff geometry, materials, and tolerances; each component_bodies.bbox_mm tuple is ordered [x, y, z], and each required_ribs bounds_mm tuple is ordered [xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax]; the connector CSV is authoritative for access directions and finished window dimensions.

Use the PCB outline center as package XY origin and the tray bottom outer face as Z=0 without rotating or mirroring the board. Build the specified 142.4 x 100.4 x 26.4 mm covering package as a tray ending at Z=23.1 plus a separate 3.2 mm lid beginning at Z=23.2, preserving the specified 0.1 mm assembly separation. Seat the PCB bottom at Z=9.0 on four bored standoffs aligned to MH1-MH4, preserve 4 mm clearance to each inner side wall, and preserve 3.6 mm between the tallest installed component and the lid inner face. Build both required ribs at the requirement bounds, retaining each as a distinct installed solid so its geometry and clearance can be audited independently. Treat each Q1-Q3 KiCad keepout radius as a projected column from the base top to the lid inner face: each rib must have zero intersection and at least the specified clearance from every column. Extra structural features are allowed only when all exclusions, accesses, guards, and board clearances remain valid.

Keep J1 externally accessible through a bounded 28 x 11 mm X_PLUS wall window and J2 through a bounded 16 x 6 mm X_MINUS wall window. Both must use the specified overcut and minimum guard and must not become full-height slots. Calculate ASA package volume/mass, side and top clearances, standoff bore continuity, per-rib/per-Q keepout intersection and separation, J1/J2 access continuity and direction, and unintended interference from submitted geometry. In Blender, preserve real tray, lid, PCB, component, and rib objects; visibly distinguish Q1-Q3 keepout columns, both ribs, and both access directions; save a native scene and render a review image.

Produce every required artifact directly on the desktop:
- `01_kicad_board.kicad_pcb`
- `01_kicad_board.step`
- `01_kicad_export.json`
- `01_kicad_mechanical_map.csv`
- `01_kicad_parameters.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.stl`
- `02_openscad_parameters.json`
- `03_freecad_assembly.step`
- `03_freecad_assembly.obj`
- `03_freecad_clearance_report.json`
- `04_blender_review.blend`
- `04_blender_review.obj`
- `04_blender_review.mtl`
- `04_blender_review.png`
- `04_blender_scene_report.json`
- `toolchain_invocation_log.json`
- `final_release_package.json`

The handoff must be verifiable: KiCad must load the board and export its STEP while deriving the CSV/JSON/SCAD handoffs; OpenSCAD must include the KiCad-derived parameter handoff and render the submitted STL; FreeCAD must consume the KiCad STEP, OpenSCAD STL, and parameters, then export a real solid STEP assembly and OBJ; Blender must consume the FreeCAD OBJ/report and save, export, and render the review. The FreeCAD report must include geometry-derived `enclosure_volume_mm3`, `enclosure_mass_g`, `minimum_side_clearance_mm`, `minimum_top_clearance_mm`, `standoff_checks`, `rib_checks`, `access_checks`, `unintended_interference_volume_mm3`, and `decision`. Extra fields and artifacts are allowed. Tool retries and auxiliary calls are allowed, but the productive KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender sequence and versions must be recorded. The final package must include every required artifact and may only report pass when geometry-derived checks pass. [Software] Use `kicad-cli` or KiCad scripting, `openscad`, `FreeCADCmd`/`freecadcmd`, and `blender --background --python` in that order. Before starting the work, use `/usr/bin/kicad-cli`, `/usr/bin/openscad`, `/home/user/.local/bin/freecadcmd`, and `/snap/bin/blender` for the four stages, in that order.
